articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: EchoStar (SATS) Is Up 6.2% After Selling US$42.6 Billion In Spectrum And Pivoting To Investments. In 2025, EchoStar sold a majority of its spectrum portfolio, including US$23.00 billion in licenses to AT&T and US$19.60 billion to SpaceX, while resolving an FCC dispute that had constrained its debt servicing and pushed it close to bankruptcy. These deals not only reshaped EchoStar into an investment-focused company but also gave it a meaningful equity stake in SpaceX ahead of a potential initial public offering.
